title: Hister: A private search engine for the pages you visit and the files you keep
why_read: A local-first private search tool for personal browsing history and files touches on a real pain point many engineers have, though it's a fairly common project category.
analysis: Hister appears to be a personal search engine that indexes pages you've visited and local files, aiming to give you Google-like search over your own digital footprint without sending data to a third party. This is a recurring genre of tool (similar to prior projects indexing browser history and local files) but remains genuinely useful and technically interesting for how it handles indexing, ranking, and privacy tradeoffs. The engagement suggests people are interested in the implementation details and comparisons to existing tools.
